title: Ten new rooms for Apocarlypse: Mobile Vault
status: Approved visual style and ten-room concepts; implementation delegated to Claude
light: Default (32,7); battery room follows engine-style (24,7); see each room lamp_anchor.
scope: Concept art and gameplay proposals only. No production art, atlas, game code or tickets changed.

rooms.name: Salvagers' Saloon
rooms.hook: Spend surplus food on a shared supper; choose who attends to build crew bonds and unlock short campfire-style conversations.
rooms.tradeoff: Attendees stop working during the meal. Morale recovery is capped; no new hunger or alcohol meter.
rooms.props: a dented barrel-counter, two battered stools, a red-brown padded bench, a hanging battered acoustic guitar, mismatched cups and a little card table
rooms.motion: A two-frame mug toast or card shuffle when occupied.
rooms.unlock: Early: after securing food and water.
rooms.synergy: Kitchen supplies shared meals; quarters provide the crew.
rooms.approval: Approved visual direction and room concept on 2026-10-26; build/testing pending
rooms.source: built-in image_gen edit of an actual in-game room, with a second original room style reference
rooms.prompt: Edit Image 1, the actual LIVING QUARTERS sprite from our game, into a SALVAGERS' SALOON. Image 2 is another actual game room and is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Preserve Image 1's exact flat wall finish, grime/dither, ceiling band, floor at native y=46, little amber ceiling bulb, native 64x52 composition and chunky pixel scale. Replace the bunk beds with a small 23x14-pixel improvised wooden bar on the left; replace the right chair with a 20x12-pixel worn red bench; add one 5x12-pixel guitar on the back wall. A couple of 2-pixel cups are enough. Keep the lower foreground clear for the existing crew. Every edge and detail must use the SAME large square pixel blocks as Image 1: this is a 64x52 sprite enlarged 16 times, so a native pixel occupies a uniform 16x16 block. Output one room at 1024x832 with that exact coarse grid. Nothing smaller than one native pixel, no new high-resolution texture, no antialiasing, no 3D perspective, no thick metal outer frame, no extra borders, no text or people. Match the old in-game art rather than making an illustrated concept painting.
rooms.normalization: Nearest point sampling to 64x52, snapped to original-room colours and selected existing furniture ramps; nearest enlargement only. No smooth display scaling.

rooms.name: Scout Dispatch
rooms.hook: Spend a map scrap from exploration to reveal two nearby detours. Choose a quick safe stop or a longer, richer salvage opportunity.
rooms.tradeoff: Detours cost travel time and fuel. No guaranteed rare gear and no extra navigation currency to grind.
rooms.props: a large folded bone-paper road map pinned to the back wall with two chunky route markers, a battered planning desk, a rolled map tube and a scuffed field pack
rooms.motion: One tiny amber route marker blinks only when a detour is available.
rooms.synergy: Uses expedition discoveries; radio retains recruitment and raid warning.
rooms.approval: Approved visual direction and room concept on 2026-10-26; build/testing pending

rooms.name: Decontamination Bay
rooms.hook: Temporarily isolate an exposed returning scout or a suspicious visitor, then spend water to decontaminate them before assigning work.
rooms.tradeoff: The crew member cannot work during the wash. It reduces contamination risk; the medical lab still handles healing and medicine.
rooms.props: one narrow olive-and-teal shower airlock with thick pipes and a ribbed hose, a boot grate, a hanging protective coat and a small analog pressure gauge
rooms.motion: A brief three-frame sparse shower when a treatment is running.
rooms.unlock: Early-mid: first infection or radiation encounter.
rooms.synergy: Water purifier supplies a wash; medical keeps its existing healing role.
rooms.approval: Approved visual direction and room concept on 2026-10-26; build/testing pending

rooms.name: Companion Den
rooms.hook: Assign a dog to sniff out one hidden cache, a cat to keep a supply run quiet, or the two-headed hen to distract one patrol.
rooms.tradeoff: Only one companion task at a time; it uses food and a recovery period. Each pet has a distinct utility rather than stacking free production.
rooms.props: two mismatched small pet beds below an overhead feed shelf, a dented feed bowl, a dog harness on a hook, and a low mesh pen with one very simple two-headed hen silhouette
rooms.motion: A small tail wag or two alternating hen head bobs.
rooms.synergy: Pets assist expedition choices; kitchen supplies feed.

rooms.name: Jury-Rig Drone Dock
rooms.hook: Charge one salvage drone and choose a quick safe pickup or a deeper sweep with better loot and more danger.
rooms.tradeoff: Costs power; a damaged drone needs components to repair. One sortie at a time, resolved as an idle job with an optional return-early choice.
rooms.props: one compact four-rotor scavenger drone folded over a repair cradle, a low launch hatch, a small toolbox and a simple monitor showing a single dim amber signal dot
rooms.motion: Four-frame rotor startup only when launching; still while docked.
rooms.synergy: Workshop repairs it; Scout Dispatch identifies a pickup site.

rooms.name: Battery Reserve
rooms.hook: Store daytime surplus power, then choose to hold an emergency reserve or discharge it for a night push.
rooms.tradeoff: Batteries occupy a room and add weight; discharge is finite and does not generate free energy.
rooms.props: a tall rack of three heavy salvaged lead-acid batteries with bold terminals, a thick coiled cable, a manual disconnect lever and a little needle charge meter
rooms.motion: One tiny amber charging indicator; the reserve level reads on a simple gauge.
rooms.synergy: Solar charges it; power-hungry rooms spend the reserve.
rooms.approval: Approved visual direction and room concept on 2026-10-26; build/testing pending

rooms.name: Stormwatch Station
rooms.hook: Forecast the next weather window, then choose to press on or prepare filters, coolant or insulation before the storm arrives.
rooms.tradeoff: Forecasts use power; preparations use existing resources and last one weather window. They reduce a penalty, never remove all weather risk.
rooms.props: a big circular weather radar screen in muted blue steel with only one tiny amber contact, a brass-colored barometer, a folded weather chart and a narrow rack of three air-filter cartridges
rooms.motion: A stepped four-frame radar sweep with no glow or bloom.
rooms.synergy: Turns the existing weather and engine systems into a preparation choice.
rooms.approval: Approved visual direction and room concept on 2026-10-26; build/testing pending

rooms.name: Wasteland Barter Counter
rooms.hook: Put one surplus resource on offer. A passing trader presents two limited deals: take useful supplies now or hold out for a more valuable commission.
rooms.tradeoff: Offers are finite and delivered by encounters. Prices prevent buy-sell loops; the room never prints scrap while idle.
rooms.props: a mesh-front trading hatch behind a short wooden counter, a chunky balance scale, three parcels, a locked metal cash box and two paper order slips
rooms.motion: A small order slip flips when a new offer arrives.
rooms.synergy: Kitchen, hydroponics and refinery provide different surplus choices.
rooms.approval: Approved visual direction and room concept on 2026-10-26; build/testing pending

rooms.name: Scrapyard Training Cage
rooms.hook: Choose a crew member and a focus: hauling drills, obstacle practice or repair puzzles. Complete a short program for a bounded preparation bonus on their next task.
rooms.tradeoff: The trainee leaves their normal job; programs cost food and time. No unlimited permanent-stat farming or rapid-tap mini-game.
rooms.props: one rugged suspended punching bag, a dumbbell made from two scrap gears, a short low hurdle and a compact bench holding a simple three-piece mechanical puzzle
rooms.motion: A restrained two-frame punching-bag sway while training.
rooms.unlock: Early-mid: enough crew to spare one worker.
rooms.synergy: Prepares expedition or defense crew without replacing the skill tree.

rooms.name: Relic & Memory Room
rooms.hook: Display a recovered crew keepsake, then unlock a short personal expedition and a cosmetic room trophy when that story is resolved.
rooms.tradeoff: Choose one personal lead at a time; it consumes expedition time. Completed keepsakes can carry into the next generation, without a compulsory resource tax.
rooms.props: a glass-front cabinet with three large readable relics: a battered photograph frame, a little toy vehicle and an old military medal; a plain scrapbook desk and one wall memory board
rooms.motion: One subtle two-frame dust glint under the single bulb, only when a new keepsake is added.
rooms.unlock: Mid-late: recover the first personal keepsake.
rooms.synergy: Connects named crew, exploration and the next-generation story.
rooms.approval: Approved visual direction and room concept on 2026-10-26; build/testing pending
